en: A black-and-white photograph of a substantial two-story European building with classical architectural features, such as a gabled roof and prominent chimneys. In front of the entrance, a group of uniformed men (likely soldiers or police) are standing or sitting in a row. There are several trees and a wrought-iron gate visible on the right side of the image, suggesting a formal or official setting, possibly a government or military facility. The street is cobblestone, and the overall scene has an early 20th-century feel.
